results.content: President Trump’s approval ratings have hit new lows shortly before this year’s midterms, according to fresh polls from The New York Times/Siena University and CNN. The Times reported Tuesday that Trump’s 36 percent approval was a record low for all Times/Siena polls. results.content: President Trump’s approval rating hit a record low in a new survey, with just more than two weeks until voters decide which party will control Congress next year. Roughly 66 percent of respondents said they disapprove of his job performance, including 52 percent who say they strongly disapprove, according to the survey. Another 56 percent of respondents who said they are uncertain about voting next month or chose to vote early said they backed Democrats. Just more than 50 percent of respondents who voted in 2022 and 2024 say they lean toward Democrats, compared with 47 percent of voters leaning toward GOP candidates.
